review: Reviewed exact three-file integration. Failure count is per reader, increments only on settled failures and resets on settled success. Default retries follow 1/2/4/8/16/30s cap, cap never shortens a supplied interval. Existing manual/visibility queue and stop logic preserved. 10 gates pass; existing regressions untouched. Same 34 tests pass candidate, 6 fail old source. Independent tests cover slow rejection, failed manual/resume reads, stale timer cancellation, supplied 250ms/40s intervals, stopped late outcomes, and real transcript/read-position/live-text preservation through list failure and recovery. No reviewer business edits or acceptance changes.
performanceClaim: Controlled scheduling/read counts only; no measured CPU/wall-time percentage.
